Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest etwa zu gleichen Teilen im Support und in der Implementierung und sicherst beides durch saubere Dokumentation ab. Du analysierst und behebst Störungen an Kundeninstallationen, Schnittstellen und Prozessen. Du eskalierst bei Bedarf an den Hersteller-Support und verfolgst den Fall bis zur Lösung. Du führst Updates, Patches und Wartungsarbeiten im Rahmen bestehender Verträge durch. Implementierung (ca. 40 %) Du installierst, konfigurierst und nimmst Lösungen beim Kunden in Betrieb, on-premises und in der Cloud. Du setzt die im Projekt abgestimmten Anforderungen und Workflows um. Du bindest bestehende Kundensysteme über Schnittstellen und Konnektoren an. How we think about legal: At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write. Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe. Pragmatic on risk: you know which rules are non-negotiable, where there is room for judgement, and how much risk is worth taking for the business. You give a recommendation, not a list of risks. Built for scale: you set up the contracts, policies and processes that enable our growth. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. We have strong product-market fit: Ops, data, and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva, and Checkout already use Kernel across their enterprise systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators, and we are growing 12x YoY . The role You will own one of Kernel’s product areas end-to-end, working directly with the founders and the engineering team Own all stages from discovery to implementation for our core product areas and bets Data- and metrics-driven (without being obstinate about it) Tolerate (maybe even relish) ambiguity, and know when to make decisions quickly vs. when something needs more thought Bridge the link between our customers and our engineering team Help shape the product roadmap and vision for Kernel What we’re looking for We are looking for a full-stack product thinker who can own and lead product work from discovery to implementation. jobs.title: Lab Technician
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company. jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most. We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment. What You Will Be Doing Drive high-priority initiatives across the business. Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges. Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows. Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution. Research new markets, products, and business opportunities. Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions. Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes. What You Will Need Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment. Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges. Comfortable working across different business functions. jobs.title: Human Data Collection Associate
jobs.description: Type : Full-time · Location : London, UK · On-site Compensation : £50,000–£65,000/year, in accordance with experience · The Role We're building a foundation model of the brain and behaviour across species, and the data that powers it is produced in-house by a small, high-trust team. This role sits at the centre of that effort. As a Human Data Collection Associate, you run data collection sessions on assigned rigs, preparing and calibrating the setup, running the session, and making sure the data you hand off is clean and complete. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics. The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small. What you'll do Mentor the mechanical engineers day

jobs.description: - About Quandela: Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises. With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures. - About this position: You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information. Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols , improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures. We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks , working closely with our research and engineering teams. With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap. - What you'll do: Spin-based quantum experiments Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources. Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation. Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality. jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . jobs.description: Location: London – hybrid Type: Full-time Level: Senior About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment. Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. Your Role We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. The UK is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, DACH, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In the UK we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor.

We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. jobs.description: Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen. Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen. Mit wem du arbeitest Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet. Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply Enterprise Consulting. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah. Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht. Was du bei uns machst Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb. Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden. Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles. Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte. Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures. Was du mitbringst AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war. Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware. Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden. Du hast Berufse

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: Join GLS/NXT as a Technical Support Engineer and help keep the future of out-of-home delivery running smoothly. We’re building the OOH Platform - a smart parcel locker platform that connects carriers, locker providers, and end customers across Europe. As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. You handle incoming tickets, analyze logs and data to find the source of a failure, and follow each case through until it’s fully fixed. When an error keeps coming back, you push until its root cause is found and eliminated - and you build the processes, metrics, and reporting that make support predictable and transparent. If you enjoy digging into complex problems, take ownership until things are truly fixed, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-moving environment, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s build the future of logistics - together. Tasks Own incoming support tickets from triage to resolution, prioritizing by business impact. Analyze logs (e.g. Datadog) and production data (SQL) to find where an issue originates. Escalate confirmed bugs to the right team with clear, reproducible reports. Act as a technical point of contact for external partners on incidents and integration issues, requesting missing details and following up until each issue is properly resolved. Identify recurring cases and drive them to a root-cause fix instead of closing each ticket as a one-off. Build deep knowledge of the parcel lifecycle (drop-off, collection, returns, labelless flows, state transitions) and of how carrier and provider integrations behave, including edge cases. Build and improve support processes, including triage rules, escalation paths, and follow-up routines. Define and track support metrics such as ticket volume, resolution time, recurring issues, and response quality, and prepare regular reports on open issues and trends to push for long-term fixes. Requirements 3+ years of experience in technical support , app

jobs.title: Founding Strategy & Operations
jobs.description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Founding Strategy & Operations ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record : une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ; l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et e

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) Senior Software Engineer ! En travaillant aux côtés de l'équipe fondatrice, tu plongeras au cœur des chantiers techniques les plus structurants et participeras directement au déploiement de notre solution chez nos clients. Missions 🏗️ Tes missions Notre mission est de révolutionner un marché figé depuis des années par un monopole vieillissant et très peu servi par la technologie. Nous nous appuyons pour cela sur : L'automatisation par l'IA pour simplifier la gestion de la paie et le suivi réglementaire : c'est dans la transformation des usages métiers que l'IA a le plus de potentiel, et le marché de la paie et du social, largement ignoré depuis plus d'une décennie, est un terrain d'innovation immense. Une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , connectée à l'ensemble des outils métiers des cabinets, qui fluidifie les échanges entre les gestionnaires de paie et leurs clients. Une gestion avancée des données pour offrir à plus long terme un conseil social à 360° sur l'ensemble des problématiques paie et social : budgétisation de la masse salariale, construction intelligente des grilles salariales, gestion contractuelle avancée, avantages salariés, mutuelle, etc. L'objectif : développer le « Pennylane de la paie », une plateforme centrale de gestion paie et social pour les cabinets comptables et leurs clients TPE/PME. Chez Alassio, tu t'attaqueras à un défi de taille, qui te permettra d'évoluer comme nulle part ailleurs : Construire un logiciel particulièrement complexe , par son volet réglementaire, mais surtout par ses logiques profondes, qui doivent permettre de gérer la paie de façon exhaustive. C'est un logiciel métier dense, avec un impact immédiat sur la vie de ses utilisateurs (des dizaines de milliers de gestionnaires de paie, des centaines de milliers d'entreprises clientes), sur une fonction parmi les plus sensibles pour les TPE/PME françaises. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams. jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description: About the role Sift is looking for an experienced Senior Sales Engineer to help enterprise and mid-market customers evaluate and adopt our Digital Trust platform. In this role, you will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to lead the technical side of complex sales cycles, from discovery and solution design through solution presentations, evaluations, and technical validation. You will work with some of the world’s largest and fastest-growing digital businesses to understand their fraud, risk, and trust challenges, translate those challenges into solution strategies, and show how Sift can deliver measurable business value. You will engage both technical buyers and executive stakeholders , helping prospects move from technical interest to buying confidence. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth , customer-facing communication , and commercial thinking . About the team Our Sales Engineering team is made up of creative, technical problem solvers who partner with prospects to understand complex digital trust challenges and design practical, high-value solutions. We work cross-functionally across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer teams, and we play an important role in shaping how Sift goes to market. Senior Sales Engineers at Sift are trusted advisors internally and externally. They bring the voice of the customer into the business, influence product direction through market feedback, and help raise the bar for how we sell, position, and deliver value. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 The Day Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. For on-the-road, you will manage and lead driver set-off in the morning while proactively supporting drivers and their service levels throughout the day. In the depot, you will oversee any daytime under-the-roof activities and bridges required from the previous day/week, as well as forward labour planning. jobs.description: Founding Product Engineer London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available The Mission We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software. The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis. We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own. Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer. The Challenge As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will: Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for. Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it. Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence. Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap. jobs.title: AI Transformation Director
jobs.description: About Riplo Riplo is a VC-backed, AI-native advisory and technology firm serving private equity across the deal lifecycle. We combine deep diligence expertise, forward-deployed AI teams and our own AI platform to give PE funds and their portfolio companies sharper answers and working AI, faster. We are growing quickly, winning work with leading funds and expanding the team, and this hire is a key part of that next phase. Advisory: thematic research, commercial due diligence (CDD), AI due diligence, AI value creation, AI build solutions and exit readiness. Solutions: forward-deployed AI teams that turn AI value creation plans into working software and measured value inside portfolio companies. Software: building the operating layer for consulting. Clients: mid-market and large-cap PE funds and their portfolio companies across the UK, Europe and the US. Operating model: flat and AI-leveraged. Senior people work directly on the programme, supported by AI rather than layers of juniors. Team: a blend of DD consultants, PE portfolio operators, AI advisors and AI engineers, with advisory and engineering working side by side. Our team and culture AI is rewriting the rules of consulting and of how portfolio companies operate. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen. We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes. We build side by side in the office 4–5 days a week, because the best ideas come from being in the room together. If you want to sit at the table with us, roll up your sleeves and build something that matters, we want to meet you. jobs.description: In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners. We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: In just over a year, we've gone from 0 to 900 customers with very little marketing spend and a sales team of three, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We're now on the hunt for someone truly brilliant to join our growing commercial team, help us deal with a flood of inbound requests, and build out a professional sales motion for the next phase of our growth. Quick background on Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes — there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there's a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line. Having raised a substantial Seed round last year and with strong customer demand, we're scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're now starting to expand beyond heat pumps and ultimately want to build an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. jobs.description: Principal Product Manager JOOR | Product Management Founded in 2010, JOOR now services more than 14,000 brands and over 600,000 buyers across 150 countries, processing an incredible $1.7B in wholesale transaction volume each month. Backed by Macquarie Group, Battery Ventures, Canaan Partners & ITOCHU, JOOR is a Series D start-up that provides the world's most recognized brands and retailers with a digital wholesale management platform that transforms the way these businesses work. With a CEO recently named a Glossy 50 "Changemaker in the Fashion Industry" and inducted into Forbes' "50 Over 50" 2022 class, JOOR is attracting top talent to drive market dominance. With our team of 150+ experts, we maintain an established global presence with employees in key markets in North America, Europe and APAC. About the Role We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape the future of wholesale commerce. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful product challenges at the intersection of B2B commerce, data, and emerging technologies, including AI, on a platform connecting brands and retailers around the world. You'll play a key role in defining how our platform evolves to better serve brands and retailers, from simplifying complex workflows to unlocking new opportunities for growth and efficiency. As a senior individual contributor, you'll have significant ownership over your product area, from identifying the right problems to solve through delivering solutions and measuring their impact. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders to make thoughtful tradeoffs, build alignment, and deliver outcomes that matter to both our customers and JOOR. We're looking for a thoughtful, commercially minded product leader who combines strong product instincts with a collaborative approach and a passion for solving meaningful customer problems. jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: At Oxa, we're building the future of Industrial Mobile Autonomy (IMA) and are in the market for new talent. Oxa’s customers are the operators of some of the world's largest industrial facilities. Our technology transforms existing industrial vehicles into intelligent autonomous fleets, unlocking new levels of productivity, safety, and performance. ‘The phone in your hand, the coffee on your desk, the shirt on your back - they all moved through a web of ports (air and sea), distribution yards and manufacturing hubs. This is the invisible circulatory system of global trade, and it relies entirely on a relentless, repetitive shuffle of goods. Towing. This towing task happens in complex, commerce-critical industrial environments. Here, having self driving technology “do the driving” delivers immediate, measurable impact. IMA will revolutionise the movement of goods across the world's ports, airports, and yards. You can be part of that as an Oxbot’ ‘Paul Newman - Founder and CEO’ Our Products: Our products are built on four core technology pillars which come together to build a complete system: Oxa Ware – Our modular autonomy hardware systems for consistent and repeatable integration of autonomy with existing vehicles. Oxa Driver – Our Physical AI, embodied in Oxa Ware, self-driving software that enables vehicles to perceive, reason, and drive autonomously in complex real-world environments. Oxa Foundry – Our development toolchain that leverages generative AI to continuously train and assure Oxa Driver, synthesising situations and sensor data. Oxa Hub – Our suite of cloud services for monitoring, managing and orchestrating fleets driven by Oxa Driver, including an API for integration with existing logistics systems. Behind these technologies is our exceptional team, the Oxbots. jobs.title: Fractional Data Privacy Specialist
jobs.description: About us Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place. We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution. Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures. Why join us : You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work. About the role You'll be Jigsaw's embedded data privacy advisor: the person product development and customer-facing teams turn to when a data or privacy question needs a real answer. This is a fractional role (starting at roughly 1-2 days a week in-office), working closely alongside our existing Legal team. The focus for this role will be translating legal and technical complexity into commercially-focused, actionable responses to help free up teams to move quickly. In practice, this could be advising the product team on what compliance actions we need to take ahead of a new product release, making case-by-case decisions for customers with unique compliance requirements, or conducting analysis on customer DPAs ahead of a change to data processing locations, right through to how to answer a client's questions about our AI features. This isn't a standardise-everything-and-leave role. We work with customers around the world in regulated industries (legal, financial institutions, accountancy and enterprises) with varying compliance needs, where one-size-fits-all templates aren't always an option and we need to adopt a flexible app

jobs.title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Who We Are: We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us. Overview: The role We’re looking for a hands-on Operations Manager to help our teleoperations team scale. jobs.title: Platform Security Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join the Security team at Doctolib. Your mission will be to protect sensitive healthcare data while enabling rapid, secure innovation. You will be responsible for securing Doctolib's cloud infrastructure and application ecosystem, combining multi-cloud security expertise with hands-on platform engineering — contributing directly to the safety of millions of patients and care teams who rely on our platform every day. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. What you'll do Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Own a platform security workstream end to end, from architecture to enforcement: scope it with your tech lead, design the control, roll it out progressively (report-only, then enforce), handle exceptions, and see it through to full coverage. Typical examples: hardening IAM across our AWS accounts, tightening cluster admission policies, or closing a class of misconfiguration for good. Ship every change as code: Terraform and GitHub pull requests, peer-reviewed and always reversible. No console clicking, no undocumented state. Harden our cloud and infrastructure baseline and keep it hardened: IAM permissions and access reviews, secrets management, network and cluster guardrails, CI/CD and supply chain controls — building the guardrails and driving remediation of what they surface with platform and engineering teams, turning recurring findings into automation rather than tickets. Investigate and improve: lead incident investigations on the platform perimeter end to end, and continuously improve detection rules and response playbooks in our Elastic SIEM. Work in the open: write clear technical notes, drive adoption of your changes with the engineering teams they affect, and grow through code review and pairing with the rest of the team. jobs.description: Standort: Hybrid (Home Office mit Remote Video Therapie sowie Möglichkeit von Arbeit vor Ort) Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload Pensum: 40-100% Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung Warum Oviva? In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit. Die Stelle Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. jobs.description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. jobs.title: Stage Bouw
jobs.description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer

jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.
